description: This Java class defines the SubjectsModifiedStrategy, which handles SubjectsModified events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements the logic to modify a Policy object based on the SubjectsModified event.

classes.name: SubjectsModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles SubjectsModified events by overriding applyEvent to update policies with modified subjects.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply the SubjectsModified event to a Policy, updating the policy entries or subjects accordingly.
